The background shows tall bookshelves filled with colorful books under warm, bright indoor lighting. (3) The camera cuts to a close-up of a wooden bookshelf. A man's hand enters the frame from the left and slowly slides across the spines of several books. The books have white, orange, and blue spines with Chinese characters. (4) The hand settles on a white book and pulls it forward. The camera zooms in to show the book's front cover, which features the same man from the first scene wearing a suit and glasses. (5) The camera returns to the man's face. His sunglasses are still perched on his forehead, and he now has an exaggeratedly joyful and proud expression, with a wide smile and wide-open eyes looking at the viewer.
